attributes.readMe:
## Approve Invoice for Payment

The control accounts payable exists for: NO path to payment around an open variance. The command re-runs the match from the documents (never trusting the panel's display), flips a failing invoice to 'exception', and only a clean or fully-resolved match reaches 'approved-for-payment'. Only an invoice in `matching`, `matched` or `exception` can be decided. From `approved-for-payment` the invoice is paid through linked Payment records; this command adds no parallel payment model.

### Example

INV N-4471 is `matching` with an open freight variance, so the command refuses it. INV N-4480 is an `exception`: it bills PO-2026-0051 before any goods were received. INV N-4466 billed $425 a chair against a $400 PO price, carries a short-pay resolution, and is `approved-for-payment` for the PO price.

### Non-goals

No payment execution. No tolerance overrides per invoice (tolerances are policy constants, documented in three-way-match.gts).
